leadText:
Mochew City (Japanese: ウイロウシティ Uirō City) is an -exclusive location located in Johto. It is the hometown of Mollie, whose family operates the local Pokémon Center. It is located not far from Blackthorn City.

Mollie returned to working at her family's Pokémon Center alongside her mother after the Rising Volt Tacklers disbanded. Liko, Roy, and their Pokémon ended up here over a year later and were reunited with Mollie in The Pokémon Center Lady.

The city is known for its signature breakfast special.

Team Dragon Rampage mentioned a health spa opening here in Crash! Team Dragon Rampage!.

Woody Park and the Exceed Testing Center are located nearby.

==Trivia==
In BBC iPlayer captions, Mochew City was misspelled as Mossui City and Mocha City.

===Origin===
The signature breakfast special of Mochew City may be inspired by the breakfast culture of as part of its morning service. The dish that appeared in the anime resembles , which features thick-cut toasted milk bread served with paste, butter, and whipped cream. Incidentally, Nagoya is also famous for its , a traditional cake similar to .
